connect.title: Connect

permission.explain: MeshCore Guardian uses Bluetooth only to talk to your companion nearby. It does not use your location.
permission.requiredBody: Bluetooth access (Nearby devices) is needed to find and talk to your companion.

connect.bluetoothOffBody: Turn Bluetooth on, then scan again.
connect.bluetoothUnavailable: Bluetooth is not available on this device
connect.linkLost: Link lost. Tap Reconnect to connect again.
connect.untestedBody: This firmware version has not been tested with MeshCore Guardian.

reason.CONNECT_TIMEOUT: The companion did not accept the Bluetooth link in time.
reason.CONNECT_ERROR: The Bluetooth link could not be opened or paired.
reason.HANDSHAKE_NO_RESPONSE: Linked, but the companion did not answer the handshake.
reason.HANDSHAKE_MALFORMED: Linked, but the companion sent a reply that could not be read.
reason.LINK_LOST: The link was lost while connecting.
